"eesar aavain daliddar jay, mara-pita kheda jay...eesar aavain daliddar jay, kone-antre rah na jay" dipavli parv par daliddar bhagane ka yahi deshi bhasha ka mantr hai. yah pirhi dar pirhi yun hi chalti chali aa rahi hai. dipavli ki subah kali amavas ki rat ka asar kaphi der tak rahta hai. bhor hone se pahle ghar men sup-belan, thali-hansuaa ka jugar shuru ho jata hai.
